description: Conteo vehicular en las principales avenidas de Montevideo is a dataset listed in City of Montevideo open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Departamento de Movilidad. El sistema de conteo vehicular que utiliza el Centro de Gestión de Movilidad (CGM) para la medición de los volúmenes vehiculares que circulan por las arterias que se encuentran centralizadas, utiliza analíticas de video para la generación de los datos necesarios para la elaboración de planes y coordinaciones semafóricas. Coverage: Montevideo. The portal files it under the publisher Departamento de Movilidad. Its tags are Movilidad, Tránsito, Vehículos. It offers 87 resource(s) in CSV, CSV ZIP, TXT. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is dag-uy. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mvd-portal.
